reviews.text: Just recently switch our pups to coming here and don't think we'll be shopping around any time soon! Staff were friendly and great to work with!
Excellent customer service, superb care for my senior cat.

These greedy vets  gave my cat solencia without fully knowing her history and it was a substitute vet on call that day and she had two shots one month after and she died. I later found out that there was a Facebook page called solencia killed my cat.
I spoke to Sean or the office manager and he told me if they don't prescribe medication they won't make any money.

Today is the anniversary of my cat's death she would have been 19 years old. She was 19 when they killed her.

I hate these people and all they care about is the dollar

This is her picture when she was dying. Their greed broke my heart in a million pieces and I would never bring another animal there
Five🤩 stars made our day, Andrey! 💙 Thank you for trusting our team with your pet’s care. We truly appreciate you being part of the VCA family. …

My babygirl (kitty) had a broken paw and they saw me the same day. They performed an xray and surgery and accommodated me while considering my financial circumstances. I am forever grateful. All of the staff is absolutely compassionate and professional.

Photo attached is my kitty girl with a cast :’)

Thank you thank you!

Avoid this clinic at all costs. Dr. Sheehan was condescending and belittling from the start of the appointment. She communicated in a way that felt more focused on showcasing her medical knowledge than providing care for my dog.
Very professional with good vets.  Just be sure to know the cost of everything before you agree to a procedure.

Our dog was a cherished member of our family for six years. We trusted Blum with his lifelong care, but after reviewing the events of the last two weeks with emergency specialists, we are deeply concerned by a lack of diagnostic due diligence and a failure to communicate life-threatening "red flag" symptoms.
Liked on of the vets better than the other. When Miya died they didn't quite know what to do. The portal has no phone number for login issues. Not too flexible
Easy to make appointments on line. Desk staff amd vet were friendly and professional. Dr. Hayes listened to my concerns and was very empathetic.
Very kind and professional staff.

I met Dr Hayes on two occasions. During the first one he showed minimal exam skills or interest in the dog, he treated me with dismissal, talking down to me not knowing I am a physician, but hey, we were there for our first visit/ exam and for vaccines! He was the only person my dog wanted to bite and disliked and treated with aggression. The second time he evaluated my dog, he failed to recognize that she had ivdd and acute herniation in her low back, despite doing an xray. She was in a neurological emergency and if he had examined her well, like watched her walk, if he did neurological exam, he would have seen gait abnormality. He could have correlated it to the severe stenosis in her back and sent us to ED, with hugh suspicion of ivdd given how severe her pain was. Luna deteriorated over the next 14 hours rapidly overnight. She lost ability to move her paws. When we called Vca Blum , they told us to go to medvet on Saturday , but they had no neurologist or neurosurgeon there. My dear sweet Luna developed respiratory distress. She is now in heaven. There was a delay in diagnosing, failure to appropriately examine the dog. Failure to send us to ED with neurological care. Shame on Dr Hayes and VCA Blum. Shame.
Barbara, thank you for taking the time to share this feedback! 🤩 💙  …

I cannot even begin to describe how glad I am to have found your practice! In a world where most vets make you feel like you and your fur babies are just another cash grab, coming here has felt like a refreshing new start. Everything is very transparent, including pricing—which is sadly not the norm somehow—and there is an actual acknowledgement and respect for cats from everyone! Both dogs and cats have a separate entrance and waiting room and there’s also a bin with calming blankets in case your kitty is feeling anxious. Everyone has always been very kind and helpful. I’m sad for not even having found out about the concept of fear-free practices earlier but ultimately, I’m so thankful for you for providing us with real help and solutions. I can only hope others follow your example!

I scheduled my dog for euthanasia and when I arrived they did not have the plan set up, were asking me to wait, then to wait in a room "set up" on the 1st floor where normal treatments happen, then told me that that was the room the dog would be transitioned from, though it was supposed to be in a separate wing on a separate floor where you do not encounter other people or dogs  It was painful, confusing, and so disrespectful. I left with my dog and will not return to them for any future treatments for any future animals. I called and became increasingly upset as the "supervisor"  used corporate euphemisms such as,  "your misunderstandings", "sorry your perception was...", to deny responsibility for the careless, disorganized, and inappropriate situation and behavior.  I have been taking my dogs there for 35 years - since the change in the ownership to private corporate ownership I will never trust them with my animals again.

I’m not one to typically write reviews but thought this one was worth sharing. Our dog got gastroenteritis and we took her in for a sick visit. We saw Dr. Sheehan who was absolutely wonderful. She really listened when obtaining our dog’s history. She gave us multiple treatment options based on her lab results. She didn’t pressure us either way and let us form our decision as to how to proceed. She was very thorough, patient, and friendly to our dog who can be very nervous at the vet! Thank you Dr. Sheehan! Also Tanner, our vet tech, was so great with Sammy. Highly recommend VCA Blum!

Blum has become our most trusted vet in Chicagoland. Our dog had multiple medical issues and every single person in the clinic always took us seriously and supported us through it. When it was time to say goodbye, the clinic got us in same day and let us take as much time as we needed. When our veterinarian returned from maternity leave months later, we received a hand written card sharing her condolences. I have never received nor seen such sincere care. When my husband and I moved to the suburbs, we continued to drive to Blum for years knowing that our dog would be cared for exceptionally. Highly recommend.
I brought my cat in for a checkup and the entire experience was great. Dr. Hayes, Rachel and Marissa made it a very smooth visit. Thank you guys!

Incredibly disappointing experience considering all the great reviews. I was stunned by the price of my visit and was given no estimate prior to services being done. The vet jumped to worst case scenario for my pet and every screening came back clear. Warning to first time clients to ask for a line by line estimate before it’s too late.

I've held off on reviewing Blum Animal Hospital, but after receiving yet another appointment reminder for our dog Penny, who passed away in December 2024, I felt it was time.

We took our golden retriever to Blum for almost 10 years. The first several years of routine care were fine, though we noticed frequent staff turnover and rarely saw the same vet twice. Around age 5 or 6, they began recommending sedation medications for each visit due to anxiety, even though she had never been nervous or aggressive. For a clinic that promotes being "Fear Free," relying on sedation as the main solution seemed concerning.

When Penny became seriously ill in 2024, we struggled to get timely diagnostics or even returned calls from Blum. It seemed that once we needed something beyond the typical annual exam or preventative care, they were totally unavailable. I understand that they need to contract out other services (for example ultrasound imaging, etc) but they were not willing to work with us on scheduling that in a timely manner. We ultimately sought care from two other local vets—both of whom were responsive and compassionate (and confirmed that she wasn’t anxious or in need of sedation for exams) while helping us establish a diagnosis and a care plan.

Even after notifying Blum via phone of her passing, we’ve continued to receive appointment reminders 8+ months later.

If you’re looking for basic preventative care and don’t mind seeing a different vet each time—this may be the clinic for you. But if you’re looking for consistent, compassionate care throughout your pet’s life, I’d recommend looking elsewhere. We definitely will if we bring another dog into our family.

Great doctors, great technicians and friendly staff. Perfect location. Clinic is quite busy at all times but waiting times at lobby are not too long. My previous dog passed away and they were so kind, caring and professional during the entire process until receiving the ashes. Clinic is expensive and my big downside is that they don’t do pet travel paperwork onsite (you work with an expensive third party provider), so my dog goes to two different vet hospitals as we travel a lot.
Dr. Hopper and Dr. Scott are great. They take the time to explain everything to you, and are very comforting and friendly

Hi Roy, we're truly sorry that your experience didn’t meet expectations - we understand how important your pet’s care is. Our Hospital Manager would love the opportunity to listen to and address your concerns. Please don’t hesitate to reach out at reviews.vcablum@vca.com - we’re here for you. 💙  …

My first 2 dogs got great care. My 3rd dog is 8 and they haven't yet finished the stuff they promised they'd do for him as a puppy. The people who made it a great place are gone. They never seem to have any other patients when we go now. Our last trip, the vet refused to take a history, review the chart,  respect the other professionals who work with him, or consider whether his meds should be continued (so they all got cut). She misdiagnosed a neurological emergency as an issue with anal glands, which she first claimed to have successfully treated then when that (obviously) solved nothing insisted anal glands are beyond her level of skill. Wanted to talk about a workup we *just did* because hadn't realised we did it, owing to having zero interest un the history.

What really made me leave was that in the aftermath the office staff refused to respect boundaries, issued threats they claimed were from the director of medicine and generally made my life as hard as possible as I navigated the dog's emergency and my own (3 months after the series of emergency surgeries, I'm still in bad shape).

Director of medicine insists that I'm the only person in Chicago to take boundaries seriously and maybe I am, but as a survivor of sexual violence, I absolutely do prefer to be around people who think consent matters.

We are both much happier now at GoodVets. We found a good match.

They misdiagnosed my dog's lymphoma. His lymph nodes were swollen like a football, but they insisted against my insistence nothing was wrong. I took him down the street to a smaller vet who immediately diagnosed him and sent me to a …
All the people I have encountered during scheduling, reminders and my dogs visit were very nice and helpful. They treated me and my dog respectfully.

I wish nothing but the worst to all of you involved for the rest of your lives. Treated my cats well until they didn't. It was great for the first five years I gave you my trust and money and most importantly, my cats. We had an amazing vet …

The wellness examine fee is $108. But they only spent 8-10 mins to exam my cat, including vaccination. It’s the shortest visit that I’ve ever had. They told me to take the form, and stool sample. But no test at all. Remember to show them …
Lisa Scott was so patient and great with my doggie who was super anxious! Great experience at VCA Blum!
